definitions.explanation: A substance applied to skin or clothing to prevent insects, especially mosquitoes, from biting.

examples.japanese: {虫除|むしよ}け⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{虫除|むしよ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I applied insect repellent before going camping.
There are many mosquitoes in summer, so insect repellent is essential.

notes:
{虫除|むしよ}け protects against insect bites.
